build: Vite + TypeScript. three.js 3D world (src/render3d) under a 2D canvas UI layer (src/scenes). Pure rules in src/core (unit-tested).
how_to_run: npm install && npm run dev  (open http://localhost:5173, ?reset=1 wipes the save, ?seed=N, ?speed=N)
how_to_test: npm test ; npm run build ; npx vite preview --port 4173 & node tools/playtest.mjs --trips 6 --skill 0.7 --shots (playtests run against the preview build; HMR reloads break bot runs on the dev server)
current_objective: Get real players onto build 2.0 (progression layer) and measure whether visible goals + the sea story lengthen sessions and bring players back (EXP-003).
biggest_known_problem: Zero real-player evidence. The playable link and analytics now exist; the blocker is getting 5-10 casual players to open it.
active_experiment: EXP-001: does the 3D jar reveal plus 'ferments while you fish' drive a second fishing trip? (needs real players)
recent_results: Build 2.0 (founder direction D-007): goal + next banner, Captain's Log, Captain XP/levels, cast tangle risk, 5 gear lines (rod/line/hook/bait/boat), 3D sea chart with 5 seas × 4 missions, relics, Mystery Crate gadgets, 12 new species and 4 new recipes, per-sea 3D scenery and boats.

[SIM] Progression sim (tools/sim.ts): story finishes at all skills 0.4-0.8. Reef at 10-30 min, Abyss at 2.4-3.3 h. It caught and fixed a perfect-catch softlock and an economy that maxed gear in 40 min.
[SIM] Browser bot on the real UI: 10 trips, lagoon story → Turtle Buddy relic → sailed to the Reef, 6 missions, no errors.
constraints: No real-money gambling, no randomized paid rewards (needs founder/legal approval).
No sensitive personal data. Analytics uses an anonymous random install id only.
Founder approval is needed before spending money (hosting beyond free tiers, paid UA).
next_recommended_action: 1) FOUNDER: share the playtest link with 5-10 casual players. 2) Pull plays/ and run tools/analyze-plays.mjs: check tutorial completion, tangle rate, missions-log opens and the sea reached. 3) Known gaps: no late coin sink; bot reels perfectly so real reel difficulty is unknown; 24 species is more than evidence justifies, so trim whatever players don't engage with.
playtest_link: https://claude.ai/artifact/Vmwfyv5LjKtVFc31t6mdwG (private claude.ai Artifact; the founder shares it from the page's Share menu)
analytics: Each signed-in player at Contributor level or above (or an org member) writes one summary doc to plays/<viewer id> in the artifact store; only the owner can read it. Pull: ArtifactData list collection=plays out_dir=<dir>, then node tools/analyze-plays.mjs <dir>. Viewers without write access still play; their data stays local only.
how_to_publish: node tools/build-artifact.mjs, then Artifact publish of dist-artifact/mam-village.html to the URL above (pass url from a new session after an Artifact read).
